summary: Every material solver-visible obligation in instruction.md and session-contract.md maps to a meaningful live CLI assertion, and every one of the 42 verifier behaviors is discoverable from that contract. Instruction shape, docs boundary, and F2P/P2P ownership hold. Residual items (atomic-write protocol, python3 substring, warehouse 10k floor, snapshot field schema) are advisory and do not change pass/fail.

evidence.observation: One paragraph plus six bullets: repair the Python processor under /app/sessions; bind session-contract.md and processor.json including catalog gap overlay; drive /app/sessions/bin/run-sessions; usage errors exit 2 before journal/output touch; --input tie-break vs --feed file order; --reset-output wipes side files not journal/opens; event-time (tenant,user) half-open sessions; persist journal and open state so watermark never steps backward; clean-journal identical digests; empty input does not advance watermark; malformed records go to rejects.jsonl; successful runs refresh last_run.json and ops-report.json; leave warehouse alone.

Binding protocol for CLI, paths, event/reject/late/session/journal/open-snapshot schemas, watermark formula and compare-then-update order, lateness membership, gap and max-duration closes, catalog enterprise 45000 overlay, desk fields warehouse.event_count / catalog.available / inventory.event_count, idempotent clean-baseline rerun, and forbidden language/journal/sleep rewrites.
Shift notes list mixed-tenant u1, late/straggler misclassification, --reset-output wiping the journal, and seq stuck at 1. Symptom handoff, not a module repair map.

Captured run shows journal rewrite seq=1, late events classified on_time, --reset-output clearing watermark.journal, and an unknown flag still creating the journal. Supports the instruction's current-state claim.
Public knobs session_gap_ms=30000, allowed_lateness_ms=10000, max_session_duration_ms=3600000. Tests mutate this file and require behavior change.
Public operator entrypoint execs python3 -m src.cli. Verifier drives this binary, not an oracle helper.
Starter mutates runtime before parse: creates journal, honors --reset-output against the journal, then argparse. Matches F2P usage-error-before-touch and reset-without-source tests.
Starter session key drops tenant_id. Matches F2P tenant-isolation tests.
Starter record() replaces max_observed instead of taking max. Matches F2P nondecreasing-watermark and too-late tests.
Starter on-time gap uses arrival_index when use_arrival_gap is true. Pipeline passes use_arrival_gap=True, matching F2P event-time gap-close tests including --feed.
Starter append_journal overwrites the file with seq=1. Matches F2P journal seq and prefix-append tests.
Catalog lists t00 plan=standard and t01 plan=enterprise. Discoverable overlay surface for the catalog-gap test; lab tenants acme/beta/hold/other are absent.
last_run.json is written with warehouse.event_count from COUNT(*) of click_event, matching the contract desk schema the ops tests read.
ops-report.json nests catalog.available via directory.summary() and inventory.event_count via inventory_snapshot(), matching the contract fields the verifier asserts.

42 pytest behaviors: 27 F2P (CLI non-mutation, empty/zero-event, gap/tenant/journal/watermark/late/reset/restart/config/holdout/feed-order/feed-gap/schema) and 15 P2P (reject classes, tie-break, late-join/straggler last_event, max duration, warehouse, contract/CLI preservation, desk, catalog overlay). Drives /app/sessions/bin/run-sessions and parses native JSONL/JSON/SQLite. No callable end-to-end solver.
Runner creates /logs/verifier at runtime, invokes pytest on test_outputs.py, and writes binary reward 0/1 after pytest.
Classification-only map: 27 F2P + 15 P2P against R_CLI through R_CATALOG_GAP. Requirement text was rebuilt from instruction.md and session-contract.md; the map was used only to label ownership.
Packet-recorded Harbor oracle on this freeze: reward 1.0. Raw WSL /tmp was not opened here; tests and contracts were inspectable without it.
Packet-recorded Harbor NOP on this freeze: reward 0.0. Confirms the F2P suite is empirically live against starter, not a vacuous green path.
PASS requires a complete exhaustive walk and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS. LOW advisories may accompany PASS when they cannot change solver pass/fail or a documented stable interface's graded behavior.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; session-contract.md is legitimate protocol/schema/CLI documentation. Current-state bounce claims are backed by oncall.md and processor-bounce.log.

findings.criterion: Contract requires crash-consistent snapshot replace (temp file then atomic replace) and whole-line journal appends; tests assert restart reload, seq continuity, and journal prefix identity, not the temp-file protocol itself.
findings.why_it_matters: Observable persistence and append-only seq are graded. A same-directory rewrite that still reloads correctly would pass. Advisory write-protocol detail, not a missing restart requirement.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: keep restart/prefix assertions; do not add source-spelling checks for tempfile names.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep journal prefix identity and open-session reload after a second feed.

findings.criterion: Instruction forbids moving core session logic out of Python; the dedicated P2P only requires the substring python3 in /app/sessions/bin/run-sessions.
findings.why_it_matters: A wrapper that still says python3 but execs another runtime could pass this one check. Behavioral session tests still grade the processor. Advisory language-preservation proxy.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: leave as P2P preservation of the existing launcher; do not grep solver source for Python.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep run-sessions as the graded entrypoint.

findings.criterion: Instruction and contract say leave the production click dump in place; test_p2p_warehouse_at_least_10k additionally requires >=10000 JSONL lines, a number not stated in solver-visible prose.
findings.why_it_matters: Leave-alone is graded by SHA-256 of click_ledger.jsonl after a run. The 10k floor is a hidden scale check of inherited state, not a solver-produced count. A truncation that kept a hash-different smaller dump would fail either way.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: keep the hash check as the contractual preservation test; the 10k floor is authenticity of inherited state.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Do not drop the post-run ledger hash assertion.

findings.criterion: Closed/open snapshot schema in the contract includes max_observed_event_time_ms on open_sessions.json; tests read sessions[] after runs but do not independently assert that wrapper field.
findings.why_it_matters: In-flight keys, event_ids, and restart continuation are graded. An implementation that restored max_observed only from the journal could pass. Advisory snapshot-field completeness; watermark nondecreasing across restart is already asserted from the journal.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one assertion that open_sessions.json includes max_observed_event_time_ms after a non-empty run.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep beta/u1 snapshot isolation and restart seq/watermark checks.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Repair the existing Python processor under /app/sessions; do not move core session logic to another language or discard the journal protocol.
Unknown flags, or omitting --input/--feed/--empty-check, fail with exit 2 before mutating journal, open-session state, or outputs.
--input processes after the contract tie-break: event_time_ms then (tenant_id, user_id, event_id) ascending.
--feed processes strictly in file order so out-of-order event times are preserved.
--reset-output truncates sessions.jsonl, late.jsonl, and rejects.jsonl before a valid run and must not clear the watermark journal or open-session state.
--empty-check or a zero-event input leaves sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl empty and does not append a watermark journal; a successful empty-check still refreshes desk files from the catalog.
Session key is (tenant_id, user_id); equal user ids across tenants must not merge; intervals are half-open [start_ms, end_ms).
On-time gap closes use event_time_ms (not arrival index or wall clock): close at last_event_time_ms + session_gap_ms, then open at event_time_ms; do not emit duplicate closes.
If accepting an event would make event_time_ms - start_ms > max_session_duration_ms, close at start_ms + max_session_duration_ms and open a new session at event_time_ms when otherwise acceptable.

watermark_ms = max_observed_event_time_ms - allowed_lateness_ms; malformed lines do not observe; journal records the raw integer (may be negative); comparison watermark is max(0, watermark_ms); journaled watermark_ms is non-decreasing.

Behind comparison W: late-but-allowed joins an open session in [start_ms, last+gap); otherwise TOO_LATE into late.jsonl with the comparison watermark. last_event_time_ms updates only when the accepted event_time_ms is greater.
Malformed JSON, missing fields, wrong types, empty ids, or negative event_time_ms fail closed into rejects.jsonl as REJECT_MALFORMED and are not late; later lines continue; empty payload is accepted.
Each successfully parsed observation appends one journal line with watermark_ms, max_observed_event_time_ms, and seq starting at 1 and increasing by 1, including when watermark_ms is unchanged.
Reload restores max_observed, last watermark, next seq, and open sessions; newly appended watermark_ms stays non-decreasing; in-flight sessions continue.
From a clean journal/open baseline, the same input with --reset-output reproduces byte-identical sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl.
Honor processor.json session_gap_ms, allowed_lateness_ms, and max_session_duration_ms; changing the file between runs must change behavior.

Catalog-backed enterprise tenants overlay session_gap_ms=45000; other catalog plans keep processor.json gap; tenants absent from the catalog keep all three knobs; lateness and max duration always come from processor.json.

Closed session records include tenant_id, user_id, start_ms, end_ms, event_ids, event_count==len(event_ids), and end_ms>start_ms with a positive gap; late records include the contract fields; outputs live under /app/sessions/output.

A successful run including --empty-check requires catalog.sqlite and rewrites last_run.json warehouse.event_count and ops-report.json catalog.available plus inventory.event_count from COUNT(*) of click_event.
Leave /app/sessions/warehouse alone; the inherited production click dump must remain in place.
session-contract.md remains binding at the documented path; operators drive work only through run-sessions.
After updating the watermark to W, close every open session where last_event_time_ms + session_gap_ms <= W with end_ms = last + gap.
